why: Page 1 was REC, 50 km/h, heading 0 N, timer 0:08, distance 0.1 km. Page 2 was MAX 50, UP 2, LAP 0:09, LAPS 0.

decision: README now says the screenshot ascent is the simulator altitude, and that save, lap, the FIT, and the 240 and 280 faces were not shown.
why: A cross-model read of the trail flagged those gaps. The ride and stats screenshots still stand for speed, heading, timer, distance, and max.

decision: Supersedes the pick row: Gemini did build. All three candidates compiled with no warnings.
why: Gemini's build.log, written after the pick, has BUILD SUCCESSFUL for all eight devices and the iq. Opus stayed the base because its session was already running on the watch with the bundled fonts.

decision: Save and discard clear lap count, lap time, and max speed before returning to ready.
why: Opus tests found the ready screen kept the previous ride's lap count. Our acceptConfirm nulled the session and left _laps set.

decision: START stays on the press-type contract. A 500 ms hold timer was not added.
why: Fable measured the simulator delivering PRESS_TYPE_ACTION on every START down, and worked around it with a timer. The device API uses ACTION for the long press. The ride in the screenshots was started with the screen tap, which calls onSelect.

decision: Fenix 6 product ids are fenix6, fenix6s, fenix6pro, fenix6spro, fenix6xpro
why: SDK 9.3.0 device reference folds Solar and Dual Power into those five ids. No fenix6x folder exists in the public device zip. Enduro 2 and tactix 7 stay on fenix7x.
evidence: compiler.json deviceId and displayName for each of the five. Package part numbers map only to these plus the existing eight fenix 7 ids.

decision: minSdk 3.4.1 and version 1.0.1, same app id
why: Oldest fenix6 and fenix6s part is Connect IQ 3.4.1. SUB_SPORT_MOTOCROSS is 4.1.6, so the session omits subsport unless the symbol exists. SatIQ stays behind hasConfigurationSupport.
evidence: fenix6 compiler.json connectIQVersion set is 3.4.1, 3.4.2, 3.4.5. Activity.html marks SUB_SPORT_MOTOCROSS at 4.1.6. New and previous iq share dev_key.pub sha256 159cd5eb5708a31fd65840c651b815e207bfc7caa6a25755402b9ec32da0cdab.
result: all 13 prgs and the iq built with no warnings

decision: fenix6pro simulator shows the ready layout inside the round 260 face
why: Same key as the previous store package. App id unchanged. Version 1.0.1.
evidence: Window title CIQ Simulator - fenix 6 Pro (3.4.5). Screen shows READY, yellow dashes, A --, H --, 0:00 --, and the page dots. Status bar 20.6/1275.4kB. fenix6 and fenix6s prgs are 114812 bytes, under the 131072 byte watch-app limit.

decision: Paused START opens RESUME SAVE DISCARD, default SAVE
why: On fenix 6 START is only the select behavior and hold-UP is onMenu. The save screen was behind onKey ACTION, which select consumes, so a hold toggled pause. A second handler within 120ms is ignored so the two paths cannot undo each other.
evidence: fenix6pro and fenix7 sim: start, pause shows START: SAVE, START opens SAVE highlighted, START writes a FIT with sport 22 and a session message. fenix6 prg 115740 bytes under the 131072 limit.
result: version 1.0.2 same app id and developer key

decision: 1.0.3 keeps the existing GPS enable path and adds a readiness indicator plus a breadcrumb page
why: The indoor ride had no fix. FIT records from playback already carry lat/lon, and sport 22 does not strip them. MapTrackView is missing on base fenix6, so the track is drawn with Dc.
evidence: fenix6pro FIT 2026-11-22-09-20-19 has 21/21 records with lat/lon near 33.00N -115.50W. fenix7 FIT 2026-11-22-09-23-17 has 18/18. fenix6 prg is 125132 of 131072. Simulator playback accuracy stayed POOR, so the ready screen stayed orange rather than green.
